title: Between the Mint Leaves  (Entre las hojas de menta)

segments.t: Sobre la mesa soleada de la habitación nueve, Tessa coloca la mitad superior de la receta rota junto al libro botánico abierto, mientras Evelyn y Arthur se inclinan sobre las páginas de hierbas prensadas. Escuchemos primero lo que dicen.
Look right between these two dry sprigs of garden mint and lemon balm.
There is a torn cream card tucked flat against the spine of the book!
Slide it beside the top half from the tin capsule, Tessa — do the edges match?
Every tiny paper fiber lines up like two halves of a broken teacup!
Read the baking instructions aloud so I can copy them cleanly, Tessa.
Fold whole berries gently into the almond batter and bake forty minutes until golden.
Wonderful! That sounds simple enough — why did you squint at the bottom line, Tessa?
Because one big raindrop hit the blue ink right on the secret warm glaze!
Let me look through my glasses: Brush warm cake with two spoons of... blue smudge!
Blue smudge is not an ingredient sold at the Saturday market, Evelyn!
Do not panic, boss; we know the cake base, so my kitchen will test three glazes!
Three test cakes on a Sunday afternoon? Now THAT is historical research I support!
Detengámonos ahora en cada frase de este pequeño hallazgo entre las hojas de menta.
Look right between these two dry sprigs of garden mint and lemon balm.
'Miren justo entre estas dos ramitas secas de menta de jardín y melisa.'
There is a torn cream card tucked flat against the spine of the book!
'¡Hay una tarjeta color crema rota, metida bien plana contra el lomo del libro!'
Slide it beside the top half from the tin capsule, Tessa — do the edges match?
'Deslízala junto a la mitad de arriba de la cápsula de hojalata, Tessa: ¿coinciden los bordes?'
Every tiny paper fiber lines up like two halves of a broken teacup!
'¡Cada diminuta fibra del papel encaja como las dos mitades de una taza de té rota!'
Read the baking instructions aloud so I can copy them cleanly, Tessa.
'Lee en voz alta las instrucciones de horneado para que yo pueda copiarlas en limpio, Tessa.'
Fold whole berries gently into the almond batter and bake forty minutes until golden.
'Incorpora con suavidad las bayas enteras a la masa de almendra y hornea cuarenta minutos hasta que se dore.'
Wonderful! That sounds simple enough — why did you squint at the bottom line, Tessa?
'¡Estupendo! Parece bastante sencillo; ¿por qué entornaste los ojos en la última línea, Tessa?'
Because one big raindrop hit the blue ink right on the secret warm glaze!
'¡Porque una gran gota de lluvia cayó sobre la tinta azul, justo en el glaseado templado secreto!'
Let me look through my glasses: Brush warm cake with two spoons of... blue smudge!
'Déjame ver con mis gafas: «Pinta el pastel templado con dos cucharadas de...» ¡mancha azul!'
Blue smudge is not an ingredient sold at the Saturday market, Evelyn!
'¡La mancha azul no es un ingrediente que vendan en el mercado del sábado, Evelyn!'
Do not panic, boss; we know the cake base, so my kitchen will test three glazes!
'¡No te asustes, jefe: conocemos la base del pastel, así que mi cocina probará tres glaseados!'
Three test cakes on a Sunday afternoon? Now THAT is historical research I support!
'¿Tres pasteles de prueba en una tarde de domingo? ¡Eso sí que es investigación histórica que apoyo!'
Escucha otra vez la escena entera, esta vez sin pausas.
Look right between these two dry sprigs of garden mint and lemon balm.
There is a torn cream card tucked flat against the spine of the book!
Slide it beside the top half from the tin capsule, Tessa — do the edges match?
Every tiny paper fiber lines up like two halves of a broken teacup!
Read the baking instructions aloud so I can copy them cleanly, Tessa.
Fold whole berries gently into the almond batter and bake forty minutes until golden.
Wonderful! That sounds simple enough — why did you squint at the bottom line, Tessa?
Because one big raindrop hit the blue ink right on the secret warm glaze!
Let me look through my glasses: Brush warm cake with two spoons of... blue smudge!
Blue smudge is not an ingredient sold at the Saturday market, Evelyn!
Do not panic, boss; we know the cake base, so my kitchen will test three glazes!
Three test cakes on a Sunday afternoon? Now THAT is historical research I support!
Las dos mitades de la tarjeta encajan a la perfección, y solo queda un glaseado secreto, borrado por una gota de lluvia, que Tessa tendrá que descubrir en su horno. ¡Hasta luego!
See you in a bit!
